text: The Chair and the Members of the Board of Governors of Exhibition Place acknowledge, thank and applaud Peter Leon, for his years of service and dedication as a Member to the Board of Governors of Exhibition Place. A crystal clock will be engraved with Peter’s name and years of service to the Board and delivered to him along with a letter conveying the Board’s appreciation. The Members of the Board, Management, and Staff applaud Peter and wish him all the best in his future endeavors.
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Requested the Board Chair to send a letter to Peter Leon conveying the Board’s appreciation for his dedication and service on the Board.
